evidence:
Reviewed all 93 criteria (2 gate, 79 functional, 6 polish, 6 visual) against workbook quality #32 and the Harbor outcome/browser procedure. Paths below starting task/ are beneath the frozen .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-lifecycle-controls snapshot. No row-32 defect found: criteria ask for rendered states, actual authored outputs, user-data exchanges and persistent readbacks, not implementation classification. task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:7 forbids implementation/bundle/database inspection; :13-25 requires exact entered fixtures, actual values/revisions, meaningful controls and bounded visible lifecycle observations. The storage canary is expressly bounded (:430-432), not a claim that browser evidence proves absence of every possible server evaluation. Gates explicitly avoid inferring SQLite/Express from responses (constraints/judge.toml:25-29).

Distinctive evidence: Render requires a newly chosen marker actually rendered and logged (render/judge.toml:25). Shared storage requires a new saved identity and exact fields fetched in an independent clean context and again after reload (constraints/judge.toml:25-27). S10 establishes successful A then distinct B and checks the displayed input value changed after failure, defeating a stale snapshot or a default HTML value attribute (:285-298). S03 records actual completed content/input before Stop and uses new console-entry counts after Stop (:149-171). S22 compares every recorded identity/title/filename/exact source/revision after one actual restart, plus a separate valid write (:438-444). S23 compares all winner fields/revision and exact dirty fields before deliberately loading the latest copy (:450-455). S36 requires a working nested callback control, the longer outer-entry marker and a bounded ten-second absence of the inner marker with visible timeout (:479-487); it explicitly disclaims hidden callback-termination proof. Object inspection, console duration, real keyboard traversal, responsive use and visual anchors all have browser observations, respectively functional/prompt.md:384-400, polish/prompt.md:45-51 and visual/prompt.md:44-58 with visual/judge.toml:23-104.

Adversarial/conforming checks: a save-toast-only app or localStorage-only library cannot satisfy independent-context server retrieval; a disabled timer engine cannot earn cancellation/deadline credit because the matching callback must execute first; a replay-only stale-save test cannot earn dirty-editor preservation. These are rejected by the written probes, not newly executed mutation tests. A conforming app may restore a static successful picture, keep provisional DOM hidden, use server-rendered library data/non-JSON formats, proactively prevent stale Save, and use native/composite controls; explicit acceptance exists at functional/prompt.md:13-21, :159-160, :452-456, constraints/judge.toml:27 and polish/prompt.md:45-49. The caught-network-error branch may complete ordinary authored code instead of rolling back (:219); legitimate app-owned title changes are allowed (:209).

Verified raw evidence hashes and current functional/prompt/app-file bindings. post-results.json facts show S03 input value a retained after Stop; the later action emitted late-interaction-failure at line 5 and restored interaction-latest-good; S10 restored latest-good-B with visible Preview note value changed; S23 refused stale revisions 1 and 3 with actual HTTP 409 responses and unchanged winning revisions 2 and 4. S36's successful nested control completed in 403.4 ms; the longer run emitted late-callback-entered and a visible five-second time-limit result at 5106.6 ms, retaining nested-control-done. S07 records successful intercepted text/image controls, delivery baseline 2, then actual caught refusal warnings for both runs with deliveries still 2, exercising the accepted caught-completion branch. pre-results.json records an unchanged monitor through carrier create/update/load/settling and a matching successful update from revision 3 to 4 afterward. surface-results.json includes actual keyboard source readbacks and a legitimate host-title-change control.
